verdict.rationale: Runpod's Pod docs say you can connect to a deployed Pod through JupyterLab for data science work, or through VS Code/Cursor for local IDE integration, alongside SSH. Official templates come with JupyterLab preconfigured and ready instantly. Missing for 10: documentation showing the connection really is a single step (e.g. a one-click Connect button or a VS Code/Cursor remote-connection walkthrough), and independent or hands-on confirmation that the IDE connection works smoothly.
